related_questions.question: What are the side effects of the Sanofi flu shot?
related_questions.snippet: Fainting has occurred following vaccination with Flublok and Fluzone High-Dose. Procedures should be in place to avoid injury from fainting. For Flublok, in adults 18 through 64 years of age, the most common side effects were pain where you got the shot, headache, tiredness, and muscle pain.
